description.html: The Liya set contains 24 cylindrical air stones in four colors: blue, green, yellow and red. Each has a plastic fitting for standard airline tubing, so it works right away with most aquarium air pumps. You can mix the colors as you like and match them to your decor.

The porous stone breaks the air from the pump into many fine bubbles. Fine bubbles rise more slowly and move the water surface more, so gas exchange is better than with the bare end of the tube. You can hide the stone behind decor or, thanks to the colors, leave it on view as part of the layout.

A 24-piece pack is practical if you keep several aquariums or want spares. Over time the pores clog with sediment and algae, the bubbles get bigger and the pump works harder. That is the time to replace the stone. Fit a check valve on the tubing so water cannot reach the pump during a power cut.
